scope: Pinned BWM source preparation on the a800-1 training host
summary: The first pinned BWM preparation attempt stopped before checkout because the remote host has no GitHub SSH credential, while the local machine can resolve the exact pinned revision over SSH.
evidence: a800-1 rejected git@github.com with Permission denied (publickey) before cloning any source objects.
The local git ls-remote over SSH resolved BWM main and HEAD to the pinned commit 44acfd1b06f35f365f02f7bb2fc5da6beafcd6bc.
lessons: Prepare the pinned source with the authorized local SSH credential, then transfer a revision-marked archive to the GPU host instead of changing Git transport or copying credentials.
limitations: No BWM environment, checkpoint, dataset, training job, or benchmark result was produced by this attempt.
next_actions: Clone the exact BWM revision locally over SSH, transfer the source without credentials, verify its commit on a800-1, and continue preflight in a new immutable run.
